title: Concept: Google service account identity in a response
description: A service account e-mail address in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The address names the workload identity a bank runs, which tells an attacker which principal to target for a confused-deputy or impersonation attempt.
applicability: Deployments that render a service account e-mail address into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The address names the workload identity a bank runs, which tells an attacker which principal to target for a confused-deputy or impersonation attempt.
